column1: # The GPU ISA classification table. Source of truth for docs/GPU_SURFACE.md.
# Moved out of the generator when that generator was ported to Rust: the table is data -
# a judgement about which hardware operation a GLSL call lowers to - and transcribing
# sixty rows of prose into a new language is how a transcription error gets into a census.
# Columns are tab-separated: table, name, unit, on-rdna2, coverage, note.
# `on-rdna2` is yes / no / ? and is empty for the ISA tables, which do not carry it.

column6: v_rcp_f32, the bare fast reciprocal; rcprelaxed pins it via RelaxedPrecision, while full-precision rcp exercises the correctly-rounded division sequence instead
